why: reading the summonses and reading, installing, turning off and taking back the key of the person's mail tool ask whether a raise carries the press, after the person and the mail tool's own key and before the old refusal; the card keeps all five doors, so a secretary presses them only where this office's list of what the grant carries says the grant does. The install press retires the old mail-tool agent as the secretary, never as the person. Reading the mail tool's settings through the office, and saving its list, picking its account and sending its test letter through the office, are kept for the person: each answer holds the person's addresses, which pass through the office to the person and to nobody else, and only the person's own press changes them. No grant carries this read or these three presses, so a secretary is refused too.
background: The mail tool is the person's own tool and not an agent or a role card (the mailer card and its power left the declaration on 1 October 2026). The press makes the person's tool's key (criterion P60), and the page's address opens the person's page. The person's summons settings, which a raise carried, left the office with its mail.
